snippet.title: 12 Minutes of Pax Autocratica Gameplay – Colony Sim Meets FPS Roguelite
snippet.description:
Build and rule a totalitarian colony, manage the fear, loyalty, and needs of your citizens, then personally lead your soldiers into large-scale FPS roguelite battles.

Capture enemies, bring them back to your colony, convert them into loyal citizens... or find a more productive use for them.

Pax Autocratica launches August 10 on Steam.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1067360/Pax_Autocratica/
